metadata.description: Agent skills by dave8172: Upwork job sweeps, article-to-video explainers, RAM cleanup for agent machines, and clean session handoffs

plugins.name: upsweep
plugins.description: Find Upwork jobs that match your filters and see what clients in your niche ask for, through Upwork's official MCP

plugins.name: vidpipe
plugins.description: Silent 720p videos paced so every word can be read: explainers from articles, and demos of real web apps filmed frame by frame at real speed

plugins.name: clean-ram
plugins.description: Free memory on a small Linux machine: find processes that agent sessions left behind and stop the ones you approve

plugins.name: close-session
plugins.description: End a session cleanly: save what the next session needs, compactly and in sections, into your memory or notes
